mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing demand (HOUST > 500 thousand units) combined with accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates robust economic expansion that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >55% of triggered instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion with strong residential sales (RSAFS > 350,000 million dollars) signals sustained corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of late-cycle periods with RSAFS > 350,000, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO > 100) indicates expanding manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >55% of INDPRO rising periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Core inflation exceeding 3.0% (CPIAUCSL > 3.0) signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of CPIAUCSL > 3.0 instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS > 125,000 thousand persons) combined with robust residential sales (RSAFS > 350,000 million dollars) indicates elevated consumer spending that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >55% of triggered instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 6.0%) suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days during labor market stress periods.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of UNRATE > 6.0 periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.
